summary: MaterialDNA.validateKnownFields currently formats unknown keys with tostring(key). A plain canonical record can therefore contain a table key whose __tostring metamethod executes during validation, violating the no-execute hostile-input boundary even though the outer record itself has no metatable. Test branch agent/materials/HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-tests-z4q8n1 adds a deterministic regression to the already-enumerated materialdna_metatable_boundary suite; it is expected to fail until the primary source lane removes metamethod-capable key formatting.
evidence: src/shared/Materials/MaterialDNA.luau validateKnownFields iterates arbitrary record keys and calls tostring(key) when a key is unknown.
Luau table keys may themselves carry metatables; __tostring is therefore executable behavior reachable from hostile canonical input.
tests/materialdna_metatable_boundary.luau now asserts that a hostile unknown-key __tostring callback remains at count zero while validation rejects the key.
